4 /-! An actual cut-locus tree, subdivided at every original vertex and
5 junction. Every open tree edge consequently has exactly two shortest routes. -/
6 
7 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
8 
9 open Set
10 
11 /-- Junctions are genuine multiple-route targets, hence belong to the cut set. -/
12 theorem junctions_subset_cutSet (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) :
13     P.junctions a ⊆ P.cutSet a := by
14   rintro b ⟨different, f, hf, g, hg, h, hh, fg, fh, gh⟩
15   exact Or.inl ((P.multiple_routes_iff_fiber a b).mpr ⟨different, fun unique => fg (unique hf hg)⟩)
16 
17 /-- Every point marked for subdivision already belongs to the actual cut set. -/
18 theorem cutExceptions_subset_cutSet (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) :
19     P.cutExceptions a ⊆ P.cutSet a := by
20   rintro b (junction | vertex)
21   · exact P.junctions_subset_cutSet a junction
22   · exact Or.inr vertex
23 
24 /-- The embedded cut tree with all exceptional cut points marked as graph vertices. -/
25 structure CutLocusTree (P : ConvexPolyhedron) (a : frontier P.body) extends P.EmbeddedCutGraph a where
26   tree : graph.IsTree
27   exceptional_vertices : ∀ b ∈ P.cutExceptions a, (b : Space) ∈ vertices
28 
29 namespace CutLocusTree
30 
31 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
32 
33 /-- No junction or original vertex lies inside an open edge of the refined cut tree. -/
34 theorem open_edge_regular {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v)
35     (b : frontier P.body) (inside : (b : Space) ∈ openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space)) :
36     b ∉ P.cutExceptions a := by
37   intro exceptional
38   exact disjoint_left.mp (T.no_vertex_inside u v edge) inside (T.exceptional_vertices b exceptional)
39 
40 /-- A point of an open tree edge belongs to the actual cut set. -/
41 theorem open_edge_cut {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v)
42     (b : frontier P.body) (inside : (b : Space) ∈ openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space)) :
43     b ∈ P.cutSet a := by
44   apply (P.mem_cutSetInSpace a b).mp
45   exact (T.trace b).mpr (Or.inr ⟨u, v, edge, inside⟩)
46 
47 end CutLocusTree
48 
49 namespace SixVertexGraph
50 
51 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
52   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
53     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
54 
55 include graph small_faces in
56 /-- The finite cut tree can be subdivided so every open edge is a regular two-route interval. -/
57 theorem exists_regular_cut_tree (a : frontier P.body) : Nonempty (P.CutLocusTree a) := by
58   let marks : Set Space := Subtype.val '' P.cutExceptions a
59   have finite_marks : marks.Finite := (graph.cutExceptions_finite small_faces a).image Subtype.val
60   have marks_cut : marks ⊆ P.cutSetInSpace a := by
61     rintro _ ⟨b, exceptional, rfl⟩
62     exact ⟨b, P.cutExceptions_subset_cutSet a exceptional, rfl⟩
63   obtain ⟨K, contains⟩ := graph.exists_cut_graph_containing small_faces a marks finite_marks marks_cut
64   exact ⟨{
65     toEmbeddedCutGraph := K
66     tree := graph.embedded_cut_graph_isTree small_faces a K
67     exceptional_vertices := fun b exceptional => contains ⟨b, exceptional, rfl⟩ }⟩
68 
69 include graph small_faces in
70 /-- Every point strictly inside an edge has exactly two actual normalized shortest routes. -/
71 theorem cut_tree_open_edge_two_routes (a : frontier P.body) (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
72     {u v : T.vertices} (edge : T.graph.Adj u v) (b : frontier P.body)
73     (inside : (b : Space) ∈ openSegment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space)) :
74     Nat.card (P.geodesicFiber a b) = 2 :=
75   (graph.regular_cut_point small_faces a b (T.open_edge_cut edge b inside)
76     (T.open_edge_regular edge b inside)).1
77 
78 end SixVertexGraph
79 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
